hero.title: Journey Timeline pattern
hero.description: A vertical timeline of real, dated stages (rescued, foster, today) for a single dog's own detail page — the page a success-story card's storyHref links out to.

rescued.label: Rescued

cleanBillOfHealth.label: Clean Bill of Health
cleanBillOfHealth.description: A wellness exam confirmed he's healthy and ready for the next step — finding his family.

today.label: Today
today.description: Settling into foster care and looking for the right forever home.
today.imageAlt: The dog relaxing at home today

standard.title: Standard

stagesType.after: — plain, site-owned array. No built-in sort/filter and no fixed stage vocabulary; labels are free text (e.g. "Rescued", "In Foster Care", "Today").

optionalFields.mid1: is optional — a stage without a
optionalFields.mid2: just omits the date line, and a stage without
optionalFields.mid3: renders text only. Early stages of a real story often don't have media yet.

videoSrc.after: instead of an image — for a self-hosted, real rescue-day video. Prefer this over a third-party embed: a prior fleet attempt at embedding Facebook video was reverted after hitting a rights-block on posts using licensed (non-original) audio.

standard.realContent: Content must be real, sourced from the org's own posts/records — never invented backstory. This pattern exists specifically to hold a dog's actual rescue-to-today story.
